{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are systematically below true prices - need upward bias",
    "Lag effect: model misses price momentum by 1-2 daily steps",
    "Sentiment positive -> model under-reacts, sentiment negative -> over-reacts",
    "Mean-reversion bias: model still prices from old range when price has moved",
    "Volatility adaptation: model underestimates price swings in volatile periods",
    "Sentiment strength matters: strong sentiment signals (1.0) have larger forecast errors",
    "Model uses linear interpolation that can't capture price inflection points"
] }
